text: [34] sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānenapi . katamehi sattahi piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca vattā ca vacanakkhamo ca gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā hoti no ca aṭṭhāne niyojeti . imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo bhajitabbo payirupāsitabbo api panujjamānenapīti . piyo ca 3 garu bhāvanīyo vattā ca vacanakkhamo gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā no caṭṭhāne niyojaye 4 yasmiṃ etāni ṭhānāni saṃvijjantīdha puggale so mitto mittakāmena atthakāmānukampako 5 api nāsiyamānena bhajitabbo tathāvidhoti .
